How to play

Two castles, two warbands. Pick up to six fighters, choose a battlefield, and siege the other castle. Last band standing wins.

  • Each turn you control one fighter. The glowing path shows how far you can still walk.
  • Pick an attack, drag on the battlefield to aim, then tap Attack.
  • Tap Jump to aim a leap and see where you'll land. ▲ climbs a ladder, ▼ drops through a wooden floor.
  • Your bag holds planks and anything you find in supply crates.
  • Wading through water costs a little health. With your head under, you lose health fast until you get out.
  • Friends & games: swap friend codes, challenge each other and take your turns whenever you like. You get an alert when it's your turn.
  • The Field guide explains every fighter and attack.

Online with a friend

Each of you opens this page on your own phone. One of you starts a game and sends the 4-letter code. Works best when you're both on Wi-Fi.
